title: Across the Board in One
setup: Black's h-pawn queens next move and the a-pawn needs two more. Your bishop on a4 is the only piece that can reach the far wing in time.
hint: The h-pawn promotes on a light square. Find the light diagonal through h1, then the one square of it your bishop can reach.
explanation:
## The Idea

h1 is a light square, and the only light diagonal through it runs from a8 to h1. From a4 your bishop joins it in one move, {{Bc6}}, and from there it watches the queening square for good.

Your king on c1 handles the other runner: it is one step from b2, where it covers a2 and a1. A knight in the bishop's place could not have reached a square covering h1 in time, and every other move lets the h-pawn queen.
